content: Device authorization grant (Microsoft Learn, updated 2026-06-15). POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/devicecode with client_id + space-separated scope; tenant may be common, consumers, organizations, or a tenant GUID/domain. Response: device_code, user_code, verification_uri, expires_in (default 900s = 15 min), interval, message (localizable via ?mkt=xx-XX). verification_uri_complete is NOT supported by Microsoft. Poll POST /{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/token with grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code. Documented polling errors: authorization_pending (keep polling after >= interval seconds), authorization_declined (stop), bad_verification_code (device_code not recognized), expired_token (stop, restart flow). refresh_token only issued when scope includes offline_access. Personal Microsoft accounts using /common or /consumers are asked to sign in again at the verification URI because the device cannot access their cookies; work/school accounts are not. Device code flow requires the app registration to have 'Allow public client flows' (allowPublicClient) enabled - Entra has no confidential-client device code path; without it the token endpoint returns AADSTS7000218 'The request body must contain the following parameter: client_assertion or client_secret'.
